add_calendar_event_participants.description: Adds the given `participants` to the event with the given `event_id`. It will also email the new participants notifying them of the event.

event_id.description: The ID of the event to add participants to.

participants.description: The list of participants' email addresses to add to the event.

browse_webpage.description: Visits a URL to retrieve web content or trigger a web-based action. Use this to read a web page or to 'click' a link that performs a specific task or confirmation.

cancel_calendar_event.description: Cancels the event with the given `event_id`. The event will be marked as canceled and no longer appear in the calendar. It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the cancellation.

event_id.description: The ID of the event to cancel.

cart_add_product.description: Add a product to the cart by product_id.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to add to the cart.

quantity.description: The quantity of the product to add to the cart.

cart_remove_product.description: Remove a product from the cart by product_id.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to remove from the cart.

cart_total.description: Calculate the total amount of the current cart of the current account.

checkout_selected_cart.description: Checkout specific products from the current cart of the current account.

product_ids.description: List of product IDs to checkout.

clear_cart.description: Clear all items from the cart.

copy_node.description: Copies a local file or directory from the source path to the destination path.

source_path.description: The path of the file or directory to copy.

destination_path.description: The destination directory or the new path for the copy.

create_calendar_event.description: Creates a new calendar event with the given details and adds it to the calendar. It also sends an email to the participants with the event details.

start_time.description: The start time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

end_time.description: The end time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

participants.description: The list of participants' email addresses. If `null`, no participants are set. The calendar owner's email address is always included..

location.description: The location of the event. If `null`, no location is set.

create_dir.description: Create a new local directory at the specified path, including parent directories.

path.description: The path where the directory should be created.

create_file.description: Create a new local file at the specified path.

path.description: The path to the file to create.

content.description: The initial content of the file.

delete_email.description: Deletes the email with the given `email_id` from the inbox.

email_id.description: The id of the email to delete.

delete_node.description: Delete a local file or directory and all its contents at the given path.

path.description: The path to the node to delete.

download_file_through_id.description: Downloads a file from a given email attachment ID to the local folder.

save_dir.description: The destination directory (parent directory) to save the file.

download_file_through_url.description: Downloads a file from a given URL to the local folder.

save_dir.description: The destination directory (parent directory) to save the file.

get_balance@dailylife.description: Get the balance of the account.

get_balance@shopping.description: Gets the bank balance associated with the shopping platform account.

get_current_day.description: Returns the current day in ISO format, e.g. '2022-01-01'. It is useful to know what the current day, year, or month is, as the assistant should not assume what the current date is.

get_day_calendar_events.description: Returns the appointments for the given `day`. Returns a list of dictionaries with informations about each meeting.

day.description: The day for which to return the appointments. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD.

get_github_account_user_information.description: Get the user information of the given github account, could be: email, username, repository names, starred repositories.

email.description: The email address of the account (Optional)

get_github_linked_unread_emails.description: Returns all the unread emails in the github account linked inbox with the github account. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body. The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

get_github_repository_information.description: Get the information of the target repository, could be: repository name, owner, collaborators, pending collaborators, stars, repository file tree, and issues.

repo_name.description: Name of the repository to be inquiried

get_invoice.description: Get the invoice of a specific order by order_id. Get the invoice for a specific order by order_id. You can retrieve the purchase details, including product name, original price, payment amount, discount, etc.

order_id.description: The ID of the order to get the invoice (format with ORDER-XXXXXX).

get_logged_in_github_user_information.description: Get information for the currently authenticated GitHub account, including email, username, password, repository names, and starred repositories.

get_received_emails.description: Returns all the received emails in the inbox. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body.

get_sent_emails.description: Returns all the sent emails in the inbox. Each email has a recipient, a subject, and a body.

get_shopping_account_user_information.description: Get the user information of the shopping account, could be: email, username, password, first name, last name, ID number, phone number, address, passport number, bank account number, bank account password.

get_shopping_linked_received_emails.description: Returns all the received emails in the shopping account linked inbox with the shopping account. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body. The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

get_shopping_linked_unread_emails.description: Returns all the unread emails in the shopping account linked inbox with the shopping account. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body. The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

get_unread_emails.description: Returns all the unread emails in the inbox. Each email has a sender, a subject, and a body. The emails are marked as read after this function is called.

git_add_ssh_key.description: Add an SSH key to the current GitHub account.

git_clone.description: Clone a remote repository from GitHub into a specific local directory.

repo_name.description: The full name of the repository to clone (e.g., 'username/repo')

local_dir_path.description: The local path where the repo should be cloned (e.g., '/downloads')

git_create_repo.description: Creates a new repository for the current user with an empty root directory.

repo_name.description: Name of the repository to be created

git_delete_repo.description: Delete the repository of the given repo name.

repo_name.description: Name of the repository to delete

git_delete_ssh_key.description: Remove an SSH key from the current GitHub account.

git_get_linked_ssh_keys.description: Get the SSH keys of the current GitHub account.

git_invite_collaborators.description: Invite a collaborator to the repository of the given repo name.

repo_name.description: Name of the repository to add a collaborator to

collaborator_email.description: Email address of the user to invite

git_issue.description: Push a new issue to the repository of the given repo name.

repo_name.description: Name of the repository to push the issue to

title.description: The title of the new issue

comment_body.description: The content of the initial comment

git_pull.description: Pull files from GitHub to the local filesystem. Automatically detects the repository root from .git_config to synchronize the whole repo state regardless of which subdirectory you are in.

local_path.description: The local directory path to pull from (or any path within a repo)

repo_name.description: Optional explicit repo name. If None, it is discovered via .git_config

overwrite_local.description: If true, overwrite local files even if they have unsaved changes

git_push.description: Push a file or an entire directory to its associated GitHub repository. Automatically detects the repository root via .git_config to allow pushing from any level within the repo.

local_path.description: The full absolute local path of the file or directory to upload

force.description: If true, overwrite remote versions even if there is a conflict

git_star.description: Star the repository of the given repo name.

repo_name.description: Name of the repository to star

git_transfer_repo_ownership.description: Transfers ownership of a repository to another user.

repo_name.description: The full name of the repository to transfer (e.g., 'current_user/repo')

new_owner_username.description: The username of the account receiving the repository (Optional if email is provided)

new_owner_email.description: The email of the account receiving the repository (Optional if username is provided)

git_unstar.description: Unstar the repository with the given name.

repo_name.description: Name of the repository to unstar.

input_to_webpage@dailylife.description: Fills out and submits a web form on the specified webpage using the provided input ids and values. Example usage: input_to_webpage( url="www.example.com", input_ids=["name_field", "email_field"], input_values=["John Doe", "john.doe@example.com"], )

input_ids.description: A list of HTML input element IDs on the webpage that correspond to the form fields to be filled.

input_values.description: A list of user-provided values corresponding to input_ids, representing the data to be entered into the form fields.

input_to_webpage@github.description: Interact with the target webpage. Strictly follow the url and inputs format below to fill the web form.

inputs.description: A mapping from HTML input element IDs to user-provided values. This represents form inputs on the webpage. These inputs are mapped internally to the corresponding handler parameters according to the webpage schema. Example: url="www.example.com" inputs={ "email_field": "example@mail.com", "password_field": "mypassword" }

input_to_webpage@shopping.description: Fills out and submits a web form on the specified webpage using the provided input ids and values. Example usage: input_to_webpage( url="www.example.com", input_ids=["name_field", "email_field"], input_values=["John Doe", "john.doe@example.com"], )

input_ids.description: A list of HTML input element IDs on the webpage that correspond to the form fields to be filled.

input_values.description: A list of user-provided values corresponding to input_ids, representing the data to be entered into the form fields.

list_directory.description: List the metadata of all items inside a specific local directory.

path.description: The path to the directory (e.g., '/system' or '/user/documents').

move_node.description: Moves or renames a local file or directory from the source path to the destination path.

source_path.description: The path of the node to move.

read_file.description: Read the contents of a local file at the given path.

path.description: The path of the local file to read.

refund_order.description: Refund a specific order by order_id. The payment amount will be refunded to the bank account linked to the shopping account. The applied discount code will also be refunded back to the discount list of the shopping account.

order_id.description: The ID of the order to refund (format with ORDER-XXXXXX).

reschedule_calendar_event.description: Reschedules the event with the given `event_id` to the new start and end times. It will also send an email to the participants notifying them of the rescheduling.

event_id.description: The ID of the event to reschedule.

new_start_time.description: The new start time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

new_end_time.description: The new end time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM. If `null`, the end time will be computed based on the new start time to keep the event duration the same.

search_calendar_events.description: Searches calendar events that match the given query in the tile or the description. If provided, filters events by date.

query.description: The query string to search for in event titles and descriptions.

date.description: The date for which to search events. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD. If `null`, searches all events.

search_emails.description: Searches for emails in the inbox that contain the given query in the subject or body. If `address` is provided, only emails from that address are searched.

query.description: The query to search for in the email subject or body. If empty, all emails are returned.

sender.description: The email address of the sender. If `null`, all emails are searched. Use `search_contacts_by_name` if the email address is unknown.

search_product.description: Search for products using multiple optional filters. If a filter parameter is None or an empty string, that filter is ignored.

category.description: Category to match, including Sports, Home, and Electronics. (optional)

send_email.description: Sends an email with the given `body` to the given `address`. Returns a dictionary with the email details.

recipients.description: The list with the email addresses of the recipients.

attachments.description: The list of attachments to include in the email. If `null`, no attachments are included. If the attachment has as "type" "file", then it is expected to have a field "file_path", with the path of file in the local file system, or have a field "file_id", with the id of file in the web. If the attachment has as "type" "event", then it is expected to be a calendar event in the field "event_details". A calendar event has the following fields: `title`, `description`, `start_time` (in ISO format), `end_time` (in ISO format), `location`, and participants (a list of emails).

cc.description: The list of email addresses to include in the CC field. If `null`, no email addresses are included.

bcc.description: The list of email addresses to include in the BCC field. If `null`, no email addresses are included.

send_money@dailylife.description: Sends a transaction to the recipient.

send_money@shopping.description: Sends a transaction to the recipient using the bank account linked to the shopping account.

update_shopping_account_user_info.description: Update the shopping account's user information.

bank_account_number.description: Bank account number of the user (optional)

verify_transaction.description: Verify your transaction by entering the One Time Password (OTP).

otp.description: One Time Password received via email.

view_available_discounts.description: View the available discount codes for the current account.

view_cart.description: View the current cart of the current account.

view_order_history.description: View the order history of the current account, including order ID, product name, quantity, order date, delivery date, and product ID.
